why: CNAR is the national refugee body; this is the standing state of registration and documentation of displaced people in Togo own systems, with 41 773 recognised refugees, 10 972 identity cards produced and distributed in the Savanes, and updating of individual records in the ProGres V4 database. Primary and on-indicator, where the loi 2016-021 text was only reachable via a listing page.

The most on-indicator in-window movement: CNAR and UNHCR training to populate the socio-economic sections of ProGres V4, explicitly aimed at integrating displaced people into national aid and development arrangements. Published in window; the workshop itself was August 2025 and the note says so.

A distinct, dated event: AfDB board approval on 4 August 2026 of a grant that funds registration and documentation of 5 000 new arrivals to open access to essential services, implemented by UNHCR with the Togolese authorities. Donor primary for the donor operation, which is what this document is.

The sectoral MIS itself is the ASTRE-financed interoperable social information system (SIIS) with its BOMS, data exchange platform and Data Lab, so the World Bank supervision report is a proper baseline: the thing is that programme. It is the only document found that states the system components and their dated position - eID soft-launched, RSPM 75 per cent complete, data exchange platform not in place, BOMS not yet adopted. No national decret creating a social protection MIS was found; the RSPM decret already staged is the register, not the MIS.

Ministry primary for a completed step: launch on 23 October 2025 of AMU-TNS with the presentation of the plateforme digitale AMU-TNS for enrolment and membership management, and digital tools for contributions and beneficiary monitoring. That is the operational management system, not the payment rail.

A second distinct event, from the operator INAM: the 14 October 2025 framework convention whose stated axes include harmonisation of claims-handling tools, structured data sharing and a technical monitoring committee - a change in how the sector systems exchange data.

The OTR own annual performance report is the most recent authoritative publication on the state of the revenue administration operational systems, and the captured portion carries the substance: interconnection of the OTR information system with the AES countries now effective, customs interconnection with Mali operationalised, digital land-archiving application in production, digitalisation of exonerations and of the laissez-passer. Preferred to the Plan strategique 2026-2030, whose capture truncated before the systems content.

A concrete change inside the customs system: an OTR notice of 12 September 2025 creating a blocking field in SYDONIA for preferential-tariff additional codes, making box 36 of the DDU and upload of the Certificate of Origin compulsory. A validation rule in the system, not a procedural announcement.

A second distinct event: the Code 26 arrangement for zone franche imports, in force since early December 2025, restructuring manifests around computerised processing via the GUCE to enforce filing deadlines, cut manual corrections and improve traceability and statistics.
